BiblicalUsage: gongystḗs is the word for murmurer. In Jude 1:16, the text says "These are murmurers."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, gongystḗs means murmurer, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
